outcome: Simpson-Golabi-Behmel syndrome (SGBS) symptoms (overgrowth, craniofacial dysmorphias, multiple birth defects)
Manifestation of SGBS in a female carrier
cohort: A family including an 8-year-old boy, his older brother, mother, and mother's maternal half-brother, all presenting with Simpson-Golabi-Behmel syndrome.
finding: The study identified the c.1159C > T variant of the GPC3 gene in all affected family members and highlighted the uncommon manifestation of SGBS symptoms in a female carrier.
